system.description: Some Cappadocians report a peculiar aberration of Prescience in which the afflicted Cainite claims to have apocalyptic visions. The vampire cursed with Mad Visions sinks periodically into tormented trances, sometimes in the middle of performing tasks, dropping to the ground and twitching feebly. When questioned about the nature of these waking nightmares, the Cappadocian reports either visions of hellish personal agony or vivid, inexplicable premonitions of the entire clan's destruction. A few frail psyches even block out all memory of the episodes. Those who suffer Mad Visions rarely share them with Cainites outside the clan, and many are driven toward madness by a burgeoning Cassandra Complex — knowing a horrid truth of the future and realizing their inability to prevent it.
system.source: Clanbook: Cappadocian, Chapter Three: Observations and Conclusions
